'''Waylin''' (pronounced: WAY-lihn) is one of [[Rina Hafden|Rina Hafden's]] [[warder]]s.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Waylin}}{{ref|{{twotc}}, Rina Hafden}}

==Appearance==
He is broad-shouldered and clean-shaven.

== Activities ==
He is observed by [[Moiraine Damodred]] who walks through the [[Green Ajah]] quarters, sparring with Rina's other Warder, [[Elyas Machera]], who later ran off as he discovered he was a [[Wolfbrother]]. They are cheered by Rina, who stands next to them.{{Ref/book|0|7}}
